name: Alpha Badminton Centre (Slough)
access_notes: Third of three Alpha Badminton sites (with Egerton St and Auburn). Books via the shared alphabadminton.yepbooking.com.au platform — select 'Alpha Slough' (13 courts) at booking time. BWF-approved courts with BWF lighting; on-site pro shop and drinks bar.
notes: Hours taken from operator's own contact page. A third-party aggregator instead lists different hours and a $15-37/court price range — not confirmed on operator site so omitted from price_bands. Court count (13) confirmed on operator site and yepbooking venue-selector.

Bookings via online enquiry form, confirmed by centre staff, payment upfront.

name: NBC Granville
access_notes: One of NBC's 7 Sydney sites. NBC was Sydney's first facility fitted out exclusively for badminton (est. 2013); books via the shared nbc.yepbooking.com.au platform.
notes: Operator's own site lists Granville only in its 7-location roster without per-site hours/price/phone. Secondary sources conflict on hours/phone/price, not corroborated by operator — left null/empty rather than guessed.

name: Northern Beaches Indoor Sports Centre
access_notes: Non-profit-run multipurpose sports halls primarily set up for basketball, netball, volleyball and indoor soccer; badminton listed among activities the halls 'can accommodate' — no dedicated court count, hours or pricing found. Do NOT confuse with PCYC Northern Beaches (Dee Why) — a separate facility with its own badminton offering.
notes: Badminton availability/rates would need direct phone enquiry; operator site only describes general multipurpose court hire.
